title: RoLaQ: Joint Rotation and Range Calibration for 2-Bit KV Caches in Multi-Head Latent Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.20686v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) compresses the content of a key-value cache into a shared latent per token, making low-bit storage attractive for long-context inference. At two bits, errors in this representation perturb both attention matching and value readout, with effects that depend on error direction and reconstruction scale. We introduce RoLaQ (Rotation-calibrated Latent Quantization), an offline method for joint rotation and range calibration. RoLaQ refines a shared rotation within subspaces defined by the frozen key and value projections, and jointly learns quantization ranges whose thresholds and reconstruction gains are coupled to control the shared signal's response. Prediction matching and attention-output supervision guide calibration with model weights frozen. Across three MLA models and six benchmarks, RoLaQ achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared 2-bit methods both without and with token protection. On

translated_title: RoLaQ：面向多头潜在注意力中2比特KV缓存的旋转与量化范围联合校准
translated_abstract: 多头潜在注意力（MLA）将键值缓存的内容压缩为每个token共享的潜在表示，使得低比特存储对长上下文推理极具吸引力。在2比特量化下，该表示中的误差会同时干扰注意力匹配和数值读取，其影响取决于误差方向和重建尺度。我们提出了RoLaQ（旋转校准的潜在量化），这是一种用于联合旋转与量化范围校准的离线方法。RoLaQ在由冻结的键投影和值投影所定义的子空间内细化共享旋转，并联合学习量化范围，其阈值与重建增益相互耦合，以控制共享信号的响应。在模型权重冻结的条件下，通过预测匹配和注意力输出监督来引导校准过程。在三个MLA模型和六个基准测试上，RoLaQ无论是否使用token保护，均在所比较的2比特方法中取得最高的平均准确率。
tldr: 提出RoLaQ离线校准方法，通过在多头潜在注意力模型中联合学习共享旋转和相互耦合的量化范围，实现2比特KV缓存量化，在多个模型和基准测试上取得了2比特方法中最高的平均准确率。
